title: Create MonacoView component with @monaco-editor/react
description:
Create web-react/src/components/MonacoView.tsx

Port monaco-view.ts functionality using @monaco-editor/react:
- Use DiffEditor from @monaco-editor/react instead of raw monaco.editor.createDiffEditor
- Props: originalCode, modifiedCode, originalFilename, modifiedFilename, editableRight, theme
- Events: onSave (Cmd/Ctrl+S), onNoteAdded

Features to implement:
1. Diff viewing with hideUnchangedRegions
2. Save indicator (modified/saving/saved states)
3. Glyph margin decorations for comment icons on hover
4. Note popup box when clicking glyph margin
5. Keyboard shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+S for save

Key differences from Lit version:
- Use useRef for editor instance access
- Use useState for saveState, showNoteBox, noteText, clickedLine, noteBoxPosition
- Use useEffect for setup/cleanup
- @monaco-editor/react handles Monaco loading automatically

The note popup should be a React component with Bootstrap styling.

title: Create RangePicker component with Bootstrap dropdowns
description:
Create web-react/src/components/RangePicker.tsx

Port range-picker.ts functionality:
- Two dropdowns: From commit, To commit
- Loads commit history on mount via fetchCommitHistory/fetchBaseCommit
- Shows commit hash, subject, and ref badges (branches/tags)
- Dispatches range changes via onRangeChange callback prop

Use Bootstrap components:
- Dropdown from react-bootstrap for commit selectors
- Badge for branch/tag indicators
- Spinner for loading state

State:
- commits: GitLogEntry[]
- fromCommit: string
- toCommit: string
- loading: boolean
- error: string | null

Props:
- onRangeChange: (range: DiffRange) => void

title: Create DiffViewer component
description:
Create web-react/src/components/DiffViewer.tsx

Port diff-viewer.ts functionality:
- File selector dropdown showing all changed files with +/- stats
- Loads file contents when file selected
- Renders MonacoView with original/modified content
- Handles save events from MonacoView

State:
- files: DiffFile[]
- selectedFile: string
- loading: boolean
- error: string | null
- fileContents: Map<string, {original: string, modified: string}>

Props:
- currentRange: DiffRange | null
- onNoteAdded: (note: FormattedNote) => void

Use Bootstrap:
- Form.Select for file selector
- Badge for file stats (+X -Y)
- Spinner for loading
- Alert for errors

title: Create GeneralNotesInput component
description:

- onChange: (text: string) => void

Use Bootstrap:

title: Create App component (shell)
description:
Create web-react/src/App.tsx

Port app-shell.ts functionality:

- Header with 'DiffReviewer' title
- Layout: RangePicker, DiffViewer, GeneralNotesInput, DoneButton
- State management for generalNotes, currentRange

Use Bootstrap:

- Navbar for header

title: Create main.tsx entry point and CSS setup
description:
Create web-react/src/main.tsx and web-react/src/index.css

main.tsx:
- Import Bootstrap CSS
- Import custom CSS
- Render App component to #app

index.css:
- Import Monaco editor CSS if needed
- Global styles for full-height layout
- Custom styling for components (can be minimal with Bootstrap)

Note: @monaco-editor/react handles Monaco CSS loading automatically, 
so cssCodeSplit:false may not be needed like in the Lit version.

title: Update Makefile for React build
description:
Update Makefile to support both frontends:

Option A (Recommended): Replace Lit with React
- Change build-frontend to build from web-react/ instead of web/
- Update clean target to include web-react/
- Update dev target for React dev server

Option B: Support both frontends
- Add build-frontend-react target
- Add FRONTEND=react/lit variable
- Conditional logic in build-backend

Recommendation: Go with Option A (full replacement) since this is a migration, not parallel support.

Changes:
- build-frontend: cd web-react && npm install && npm run build
- clean: add web-react/dist, web-react/node_modules
- dev: cd web-react && npm run dev

title: Integration testing and cleanup
description:
Final integration testing:

1. Run make build and verify binary works
2. Test all features:
   - Commit range selection
   - File navigation
   - Diff viewing with Monaco
   - Inline notes via glyph click
   - General notes auto-save
   - File editing and Cmd/Ctrl+S save
   - Done button and graceful shutdown
3. Fix any issues found

Cleanup:
- Remove web/ directory (old Lit frontend) after React is verified
- Update CLAUDE.md to document React frontend
- Update any documentation references

title: React Frontend Migration
description: Epic: Migrate DiffReviewer frontend from Lit to React with Bootstrap and @monaco-editor/react. This involves creating a new build system with Vite+React, replacing all Lit components with React equivalents, and integrating @monaco-editor/react for diff viewing.

title: Create new React web directory with Vite build
description:
Create web-react/ directory with:
- package.json with React, React-DOM, Vite, @monaco-editor/react, react-bootstrap, bootstrap
- vite.config.ts configured for React (same proxy setup as existing)
- tsconfig.json for React with JSX
- index.html entry point

Key dependencies:
- react@18, react-dom@18
- @monaco-editor/react (instead of raw monaco-editor)
- react-bootstrap + bootstrap CSS
- typescript, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react

Build should output to web-react/dist/ which gets copied to cmd/diffreviewer/web-dist/

title: Port TypeScript types and API services to React
description:
Port existing services/api.ts and services/notes.ts to web-react/src/services/
Port types.ts to web-react/src/types.ts

These are framework-agnostic and can be copied with minimal changes:
- types.ts: DiffFile, Note, NotesResponse, GitLogEntry, etc.
- api.ts: fetchDiff, fetchFileContent, saveFileContent, fetchCommitHistory, etc.
- notes.ts: fetchNotes, addNote, updateGeneralNotes, etc.

No changes needed to function signatures or logic.
